# WayTara Energy

> WayTara Energy designs, installs and monitors integrated rooftop solar, smart LFP battery storage and EV charging systems in India, under one accountable warranty. Based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Customers get a live monitoring dashboard for their system.

Website: https://www.waytaraenergy.com
Contact: hello@waytaraenergy.com · +91 93630 21195
Address: No. 6 & 7, 3rd Floor, 5th Street, Dr. Radhakrishnan Salai, Mylapore, Chennai - 600 004, India
Service area: India

## What WayTara does

- Rooftop solar (Tier-1 TOPCon modules) for homes, apartments, factories, offices and EV fleets
- Smart lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery storage with sub-20 ms backup transfer
- EV charging, from home AC chargers to DC fast-charging depots
- One cloud dashboard for monitoring generation, consumption, battery, grid and EV charging
- One accountable warranty covering the integrated system (solar + storage + EV charging), instead of separate vendors

## Solutions by property type

- [Home Independence](https://www.waytaraenergy.com/solutions/home): villas and residences. Solar with smart LFP storage for zero-flicker blackout backup and grid bills cut by up to 90%.
- [Apartments & Gated Communities](https://www.waytaraenergy.com/solutions/apartment): shared rooftop solar and central battery storage for lifts, pumps and STPs, with EV sub-metering.
- [Industrial & Manufacturing](https://www.waytaraenergy.com/solutions/factory): MW-scale solar and industrial BESS to cut peak-demand penalties and diesel generator use.
- [Commercial & Workspaces](https://www.waytaraenergy.com/solutions/commercial): solar carports and rooftop PV for offices, hospitals, hotels and retail.
- [EV Fleet & Transit Depots](https://www.waytaraenergy.com/solutions/ev-fleet): DC fast-charging depots with on-site solar and containerised BESS.
- [IT Parks & Data Campuses](https://www.waytaraenergy.com/solutions/it-park): zero-downtime microgrids with millisecond UPS transfer and peak-load shaving.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices, subsidy amounts and savings figures on the site are indicative and depend on site assessment; direct users to the contact page for a quotation.
- The customer dashboard (www.waytaraenergy.com/dashboard) and the staff admin app (admin.waytaraenergy.com) require sign-in and are not public.
